senses.definition: a formal or official social gathering or ceremony of people
examples: the party was quite an affair
an occasion arranged to honor the president
a seemingly endless round of social functions

senses.definition: a rational motive for a belief or action
examples: the reason that war was declared
the grounds for their declaration

senses.definition: an event that occurs at a critical time
examples: at such junctures he always had an impulse to leave
it was needed only on special occasions

senses.definition: an opportunity to do something
examples: there was never an occasion for her to demonstrate her skill

senses.definition: the time of a particular event
examples: on the occasion of his 60th birthday

senses.definition: give occasion to
occurring from time to time
examples: took an occasional glass of wine

senses.definition: occurring on a temporary or irregular basis
examples: casual employment
a casual correspondence with a former teacher
an occasional worker

senses.definition: occurring or appearing at usually irregular intervals
examples: episodic in his affections
occasional headaches

senses.definition: recurring or reappearing from time to time
examples: periodic feelings of anxiety

senses.definition: sporadically and infrequently
examples: he was arrogant and occasionally callous
open areas are only occasionally interrupted by clumps of trees
they visit New York on occasion
now and again she would take her favorite book from the shelf and read to us
as we drove along, the beautiful scenery now and then attracted his attention

senses.definition: someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
any activity that occupies a person's attention
examples: he missed the bell in his occupation with the computer game

senses.definition: the act of occupying or taking possession of a building
examples: occupation of a building without a certificate of occupancy is illegal

senses.definition: the control of a country by military forces of a foreign power
the period of time during which a place or position or nation is occupied
examples: during the German occupation of Paris

senses.definition: the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
examples: he's not in my line of business

senses.definition: of or relating to the activity or business for which you are trained
examples: occupational hazard

senses.definition: assume, as of positions or roles
examples: She took the job as director of development
he occupies the position of manager
the young prince will soon occupy the throne

senses.definition: be on the mind of
examples: I worry about the second Germanic consonant shift

senses.definition: consume all of one's attention or time
examples: Her interest in butterflies absorbs her completely

senses.definition: keep busy with
examples: She busies herself with her butterfly collection

senses.definition: live (in a certain place)
examples: She resides in Princeton
he occupies two rooms on the top floor

senses.definition: march aggressively into another's territory by military force for the purposes of conquest and occupation
examples: Hitler invaded Poland on September 1, 1939

senses.definition: occupy the whole of
examples: The liquid fills the container

senses.definition: require (time or space)
examples: It took three hours to get to work this morning
This event occupied a very short time

senses.definition: come to one's mind; suggest itself
examples: It occurred to me that we should hire another secretary
A great idea then came to her

senses.definition: come to pass
examples: What is happening?
The meeting took place without an incident
Nothing occurred that seemed important

senses.definition: to be found to exist
examples: sexism occurs in many workplaces
precious stones occur in a large area in Brazil

senses.definition: a large body of water constituting a principal part of the hydrosphere
anything apparently limitless in quantity or volume
the month following September and preceding November
being from 80 to 89 years old
someone whose age is in the eighties
